Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5147-5254-6774.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

Use Stiltzkin to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2.

When Inferno Titan enters, it triggers, dealing 3 damage to Smaug.

Repeat.

When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Lotus Cobra and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

Repeat.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Heronblade Elite.

Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Heronblade Elite.

Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Benevolent Hydra and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

810-7299.description:
Activate Magus of the Disk by paying {1} and tapping it, destroying all creatures, enchantments and artifacts.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
810-7299.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

1894-5220-6900-7192.description:
Cast Bile Urchin by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

Activate Command Beacon's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Lumra from the command zone into your hand.
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

Ertha Jo and the creature trigger.

Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Flameshadow Conjuring trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Parallel Lives that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Parallel Lives tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

1636-2110-2292-2527-4170.notablePrerequisites: Fain and Princess Lucrezia do not have summoning sickness.
1636-2110-2292-2527-4170.description:
Activate Princess Lucrezia by tapping it, adding {U}.
Princess Lucrezia triggers, giving creatures that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
Viscera Seer dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Viscera Seer enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 3, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing the +1/+1 counter from Viscera Seer, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to get infinite Inklings, and thus infinite +1/+1 counters via Fain.

Repeat.

You control creatures that can produce at least {5}{W}.
Chulane does not have summoning sickness.
2059-2836-3314.description:
Activate creatures by tapping them, adding at least {5}{W}.
Cast Village Bell-Ringer by paying {2}{W}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
In response, activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Village Bell-Ringer from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat until your library is empty.

Repeat stpes 1 through 3.
